Don't exfoliate too often; try about once a week.
If it's too irritating, wait until your skin has healed before doing so!

Soonyul is a cream that removes impurities and dead skin cells,
so it's great for those who find exfoliation a burden.
Atobarrier is a cream that also provides barrier care,
so it can also care for a damaged skin barrier, making it great for those concerned about their skin barrier!

so using just one of the three creams is sufficient.
If you need more hydration, apply one of the two creams to boost the moisture content.
